name: trace
useFor: Use to show what the agent did or is doing to answer (Matched the parcel, Checked the flood zone, Sampled elevation and slope), in the past tense once done. Lead each TraceLine with a TraceNode, or a TraceIcon when the tool matters. Set status running, pending or error. Put a step with detail in TraceCollapsible, its line inside TraceCollapsibleTrigger. Wrap a line in a link or button to make it open something.
constraints: Circles or check marks for steps
A spinner on every running step
A chevron that moves on hover
source: Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): Steps 443:445 to 443:453; UI · Loaders, agent (443:234): the current node

Sampling elevation and slope Writing the report ); } export function Failed() { return ( Searched Ellis County parcels 38 results Elevation model did not respond The source answered 503 Service Unavailable. Slope and elevation are left out of this answer. Retry scheduled in 30s ); } export function Linked() { return ( Opened parcel 042-117-09 ); }
